materials.surfacePolicy: Simplified matte albedo fields. Recesses and trim are selective geometry; no photo textures, brick grain, asphalt noise, pores or procedural dirt.

materials.foliage: Irregular organic lobed crowns, selective silhouette detail; no repeated spherical clusters, no dense leaf microgeometry.
materials.detailLevel: Real proportions and silhouette; selective structural detail, simplified surface information.

peopleVehicles.policy: Near-photoreal generic form under the same matte lighting, no brands, detailed faces, readable signage or insignia.

distanceBands.people: Real anatomy, gait, clothing folds at broad scale; non-identifying facial planes, no detailed features.
distanceBands.vehicles: Real class proportions, wheels, broad glass and panel forms; no badge, identifying grille or plate text.

distanceBands.vehicles: Silhouette, wheel placement, glass groups; merge small trim.

renderPolicy.signText: none: no real names, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing or brands. Generic shape-only depiction intentionally omits mandatory real-world legends.
renderPolicy.placement: mapped positions/orientations win; generated assets labelled inferred with stable ID seed. Never relocate mapped objects. No automatic traffic-signal placement based only on a national profile.
renderPolicy.signalState: simulation unless actual supported feed. No conflicting greens; dark fixture when unknown. One active lamp in ordinary illustrative head; UK red+amber is a distinct legal transition and not modeled as green.
tierDetails: near: visor, black backplate, thin border and generic pictogram
mid: silhouette, colour group and one lamp; remove bolts/mesh pictograms
far: actual-scale coloured plate and head; never enlarge sign/lamp to force reading
cull ambient inferred sign below2px; mapped critical inventory remains data even when not drawn
renderPolicy.fades: 20% projected-size overlap, geometric LOD morph/fade without stacked alpha panels
renderPolicy.material: Matte .68 painted metal inherited; bounded broad retroreflection only if a light is supported, no chrome or emissive signs.
renderPolicy.emission: lamp emissive area only, no point light per signal; no bloom enlargement; exposure once

budgetProposal.status: unbenchmarked allocation inside existing scene budget, not additional entitlement

renderPolicy.performance: instance poles/heads, common opaque palette atlas; crosswalk decals in road material; no unique texture per name, no coplanar z-fighting. Shadow-cull fine visors at distance.
